value: You know the unceasing attacks of my invisible enemies and the infirmity of my wretched flesh, O Creator. Therefore I commit my spirit into Your hands. Shelter me under the wings of Your mercy, lest I sleep in death.

Glory: O Lord, my God, attend to me and hear me. For awesome is Your judgment, O Lord, with the angels standing by, men being brought in, the books opened, deeds examined, and thoughts tested. What manner of judgment shall be mine, for I am condemned by my own conscience?
Now and ever: O Theotokos, you are the true vine who bore the fruit of life. Intercede for us, O Lady, together with the apostles and all the saints, that He may have mercy on our souls.
